verdict.overall: No Sunday baseline is available for any name, so this read compares to Tuesday's prior scan: moves were mostly small (under 1.5%) and setups held steady, except APP, BE, SPY and QQQ where today's options trading was unusually heavy relative to contracts already sitting at the magnet level, making those near-term magnets less reliable right now.
